objective: Re-prove the containment properties introduced by the accepted INV-38 and provider-plane canon changes without rewriting any M1 or M2 predecessor closure. M2_ISOLATION_CONTAINMENT_ENFORCEMENT_SUCCESSOR_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: Every host-execution, cache, export, restore, and environment-class path affected by containment either supplies verified isolation evidence or refuses before effect; no default or fallback path may manufacture an isolation claim.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

in_scope: INV-38 implementation coverage and the non-self-referential EnvironmentClass availability derivation.
Default-off containment gates, host-fallback refusal, scoped caches, export and restore containment, and isolation evidence at the final decision point.
Local adversarial branches that prove denial without cloud credentials.
out_of_scope: Claiming that a VM proves containment
positive_proof: The containment verifier derives the affected paths from code and canon, exercises the admitted branch, and reports every unavailable branch explicitly.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Refuse host fallback, unverified isolation, cross-scope cache access, and self-referential EnvironmentClass availability; prove each rejection by name.
remaining_nonclaims: A passing source-local proof establishes the tested containment decisions, not resistance to a hostile kernel, VMM, proxy, or physical host.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop on any affected path that can reach an effect with unverified isolation, an ambient credential, a shared host mount, or a self-declared EnvironmentClass availability value.
source_provenance: Owner-ordered containment successor authored 2026-07-29 under the open certification hold; predecessor bytes and statuses remain untouched.

last_status_transaction.rule: Derived by tools/transition.mjs from one retained certification result. No downstream artifact was hand-edited.
